question: ¿Cuántas concesiones con al menos una anomalía térmica desde enero de 2024 están a 10 km o más del gasoducto de transporte de ENARGAS más cercano?

attempts.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT c.id_concesion, p.ord AS i, (p.pt->>0)::float AS x, (p.pt->>1)::float AS y
  FROM sig_energia.concesion c,
       jsonb_array_elements(c.anillo::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY p(pt, ord)
  WHERE c.anillo IS NOT NULL AND c.anillo <> ''
),
e AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, x AS x1, y AS y1,
         COALESCE(lead(x) OVER w, first_value(x) OVER w) AS x2,
         COALESCE(lead(y) OVER w, first_value(y) OVER w) AS y2
  FROM v WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY id_concesion ORDER BY i)
),
bb AS (
  SELECT id_concesion, min(x) xmin, max(x) xmax, min(y) ymin, max(y) ymax FROM v GROUP BY id_concesion
),
con_anom AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT e.id_concesion, d.gml_id
    FROM sig_energia.venteo_detectado d
    JOIN bb ON d.lon BETWEEN bb.xmin AND bb.xmax AND d.lat BETWEEN bb.ymin AND bb.ymax
    JOIN e ON e.id_concesion = bb.id_concesion
          AND ((e.y1 > d.lat) <> (e.y2 > d.lat))
          AND d.lon < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (d.lat - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
    WHERE d.fecha >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    GROUP BY e.id_concesion, d.gml_id
    HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
  ) t
),
gp AS (
  SELECT g.gml_id, l.ord AS li, p.ord AS pi, (p.pt->>0)::float AS x, (p.pt->>1)::float AS y
  FROM enargas.gasoducto g,
       jsonb_array_elements(g.lineas::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY l(line, ord),
       jsonb_array_elements(l.line) WITH ORDINALITY p(pt, ord)
),
gs AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT x AS ax, y AS ay, lead(x) OVER w AS bx, lead(y) OVER w AS by_
    FROM gp WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY gml_id, li ORDER BY pi)
  ) s WHERE bx IS NOT NULL
),
cerca AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v.id_concesion
  FROM v
  JOIN con_anom a ON a.id_concesion = v.id_concesion
  JOIN gs ON LEAST(gs.ax, gs.bx) <= v.x + 0.2 AND GREATEST(gs.ax, gs.bx) >= v.x - 0.2
         AND LEAST(gs.ay, gs.by_) <= v.y + 0.15 AND GREATEST(gs.ay, gs.by_) >= v.y - 0.15
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 111.32 * cos(radians(v.y)) AS kx, 110.57 AS ky
  ) k
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (gs.ax - v.x) * k.kx AS axk, (gs.ay - v.y) * k.ky AS ayk,
           (gs.bx - v.x) * k.kx AS bxk, (gs.by_ - v.y) * k.ky AS byk
  ) q
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT CASE WHEN (q.bxk - q.axk)^2 + (q.byk - q.ayk)^2 = 0 THEN 0
                ELSE GREATEST(0, LEAST(1, -(q.axk * (q.bxk - q.axk) + q.ayk * (q.byk - q.ayk))
                     / ((q.bxk - q.axk)^2 + (q.byk - q.ayk)^2))) END AS t
  ) tt
  WHERE sqrt((q.axk + tt.t * (q.bxk - q.axk))^2 + (q.ayk + tt.t * (q.byk - q.ayk))^2) < 10
),
adentro AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id_concesion FROM (
    SELECT e.id_concesion, gp.gml_id, gp.li, gp.pi
    FROM gp
    JOIN bb ON gp.x BETWEEN bb.xmin AND bb.xmax AND gp.y BETWEEN bb.ymin AND bb.ymax
    JOIN con_anom a ON a.id_concesion = bb.id_concesion
    JOIN e ON e.id_concesion = bb.id_concesion
          AND ((e.y1 > gp.y) <> (e.y2 > gp.y))
          AND gp.x < (e.x2 - e.x1) * (gp.y - e.y1) / (e.y2 - e.y1) + e.x1
    GROUP BY e.id_concesion, gp.gml_id, gp.li, gp.pi
    HAVING count(*) % 2 = 1
  ) t
)
SELECT count(*) FROM con_anom a
WHERE a.id_concesion NOT IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM cerca)
  AND a.id_concesion NOT IN (SELECT id_concesion FROM adentro)
